biggest_catch: The bonus is real but modest ($100 for $500 spend), and the card is only available to U.S. residents in M&T's footprint — never buy extra just to hit the $500 threshold.
catches: Never spend extra solely to chase the $500 threshold — only use spending you already planned.
The card has no annual fee, which is good, but carrying a balance after the 0% intro period at 17.74%–21.74% variable APR erases the bonus many times over — pay in full.
Applying involves a hard credit inquiry when M&T processes the application.
Returns are deducted from the purchase total, so a large return can drop you below the $500 threshold.
The account must be open, all minimum payments on time, and not in default at fulfillment; offer is one 10,000-point award per rewards program account.
Cash advances, balance transfers, fees, and unauthorized/fraudulent charges do not count as purchases toward the $500 threshold.

steps: Open the official M&T page https://www.mtb.com/personal/credit-cards/m-and-t-visa-signature-credit-card and apply for the M&T Visa Signature Credit Card — do not apply from an affiliate link with different terms.
Complete the application; M&T runs a hard credit inquiry when you apply.
If approved, spend $500 on purchases you were already planning within the first 90 days of account opening.
Pay the balance in full every month — carrying a balance at 17.74%–21.74% variable APR after the intro period destroys the bonus.
The 10,000 bonus points post to your M&T Rewards account; redeem for $100 cash back or statement credit.
